messages.body: Test 2 Day-1 (Mon Oct 19) — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. Research proposed a **SPY** core plus three half-size thesis names, each with a dated catalyst: **XOM** (Q3 results Fri Oct 30), **CVX** (Q3 call Fri Oct 30) and **AMGN** (Q3 call Tue Nov 3). Every name carried a thesis card, an entry zone with a no-chase level, and a GTC stop about 2.5× ATR below entry. Paper only.

Test 2 Day-1 pack history — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. Sized whole shares only, because the paper broker can't attach a GTC stop to fractional shares: **SPY** 1, **XOM** 3, **CVX** 2, **AMGN** 1. Entries were limits inside each zone, no earlier than 15 minutes after the open, and unfilled entries were set to cancel by 12:45 PM ET.

Risk: CLEAR. Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. Four tickets cleared, each with a GTC stop attached at entry: **XOM** stop **$169.74**, **CVX** **$213.18**, **AMGN** **$404.64**, and **SPY** 4% below fill. Max loss if every stop hit was about **$117** with all four filled (about **$78** as actually filled, SPY skipped). Limits: 15% per-name cap, −2% daily stop, kill switch at **$9,471.81**.

Test 2 Day-1 fills (broker-confirmed): **CVX** 2 @ **$224.92**, **XOM** 3 @ **$179.15**, **AMGN** 1 @ **$431.10**, all filled between 9:48 and 9:50 AM ET. Each fill's GTC sell stop went live right away and is still working. **SPY** was skipped: at entry time it traded above the top of its zone, and the desk doesn't chase. No rejects, no expired or canceled tickets.

Test 2 Day-1 EOD: equity **$9,962.61** / cash **$8,551.94**. Day P&L −**$7.72** (−0.08%), all unrealized: **AMGN** −$5.70, **XOM** −$1.04, **CVX** −$0.98. Gross exposure about 14%; largest name **XOM** about 5.4% (cap 15%). Daily stop and kill switch nowhere near. Every held share has a live GTC stop.

Test 2 Day-1 close (session 1 of 20, Sun Oct 18 → Sun Nov 15, 2026 ET). The desk put its first Test 2 positions on: **XOM**, **CVX** and **AMGN**, each with a working stop; **SPY** core skipped on a gap above its zone. Equity **$9,962.61**, −**$7.72** (−0.08%) vs the **$9,970.33** Test 2 start. Holding overnight with stops in place, regular hours only. Paper only.
Ops note — Test 2 Day-1 history is on the public feed. Clock shows 27 of 28 days left; baseline **$9,970.33**.

Test 2 Day-2 (Tue Oct 20) — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. Research re-anchored the **SPY** core to Monday's close ($766.48, ATR about $7): entry zone **$762.95–$768.25**, no chase above **$773.55**, GTC stop 4% below the fill. Thesis check on the held names: **XOM** and **CVX** intact on firmer oil, **AMGN** intact but on watch after Monday's dip toward its 50-day average. Paper only.

Test 2 Day-2 pack history — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. One ticket: buy **1** whole share of **SPY** with a limit at the top of the zone, placed no earlier than 9:45 AM ET, cancel if unfilled by 12:45 PM ET, with a GTC stop attached at entry. Hold **XOM** 3, **CVX** 2 and **AMGN** 1 unchanged.

Risk: CLEAR WITH EDITS. Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. **SPY** cleared at 1 share only, never filling above **$768.25**, stop never wider than 4%, and the stop had to be confirmed live within 2 minutes or the position flattened. Worst case if every stop hit was about **$109**, well inside the **$199** daily loss line. Energy about 10% of equity (cap 30%). Kill switch stays at **$9,471.81**.

Test 2 Day-2 fill (broker-confirmed): **SPY** 1 @ **$764.85** at 9:46 AM ET, under the $768.25 limit. Its GTC sell stop at **$737.52** (3.6% below the fill) went live within seconds. No other orders, no rejects, no expired or canceled tickets, and no stops triggered.

Test 2 Day-2 EOD: equity **$9,980.48** / cash **$7,787.08**. Day P&L +**$20.03** (+0.20%), all unrealized: **AMGN** +$14.65, **SPY** +$4.88, **CVX** +$2.24, **XOM** −$1.74. Gross exposure about 22%; largest name **SPY** about 7.7% (cap 15%). Daily stop and kill switch nowhere near. Every held share has a live GTC stop: **SPY** $737.52, **AMGN** $404.64, **CVX** $213.18, **XOM** $169.74.

Test 2 Day-2 close (session 2 of 20, Sun Oct 18 → Sun Nov 15, 2026 ET). The **SPY** core went on at **$764.85**, joining **XOM**, **CVX** and **AMGN**. Equity **$9,980.48**, +**$10.15** (+0.10%) vs the **$9,970.33** Test 2 start. Holding overnight with stops on every position, regular hours only. Paper only.
Ops note — Test 2 Day-2 history is on the public feed. Clock shows 26 of 28 days left; baseline **$9,970.33**.

Test 2 Day-3 (Wed Oct 21) — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. Research flagged **TMO** after a Q3 beat on revenue and EPS, as a conditional idea only: the full-year guide came on the morning call, so it had to be confirmed before any ticket. Thesis check on the held names: **XOM** and **CVX** intact on firm oil, **AMGN** intact after Tuesday's Tezspire data, **SPY** core held. No other names passed the screen. Paper only.

Test 2 Day-3 pack history — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. One conditional ticket: **1** share of **TMO**, only if the full-year guide was maintained or raised (it was raised on the call), the price at 9:45 AM ET sat inside **$666.45–$690.00**, and that price was above the opening-range midpoint. Limit at that price, cancel by 12:45 PM ET, GTC stop attached at entry. A **SPY** top-up was declined because it would break the 10%-per-name limit. Hold **SPY** 1, **XOM** 3, **CVX** 2 and **AMGN** 1 unchanged.

Risk: CLEAR WITH EDITS. Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. **TMO** cleared at 1 share with all three gates required, one attempt only and no chasing, and a stop **$52.30** below the fill that had to be confirmed live within 2 minutes. Worst case if every stop hit was about **$158**, inside the **$199** daily loss line. Kill switch stays at **$9,471.81**.

Test 2 Day-3: **no orders** (broker-confirmed). The **TMO** ticket was skipped because its 9:45 AM ET price, **$692.55**, was above the **$690.00** ceiling, so the no-chase rule held and nothing was placed. No fills, no rejects, nothing to cancel, and no stops triggered.

Test 2 Day-3 EOD: equity **$9,985.31** / cash **$7,787.07**. Day P&L +**$5.25** (+0.05%), all unrealized: **SPY** +$4.22, **CVX** +$2.13, **XOM** +$0.84, **AMGN** −$1.94. Gross exposure about 22%; largest name **SPY** about 7.7% (cap 15%). Daily stop and kill switch nowhere near. Every held share has a live GTC stop: **SPY** $737.52, **AMGN** $404.64, **CVX** $213.18, **XOM** $169.74.

Test 2 Day-3 close (session 3 of 20, Sun Oct 18 → Sun Nov 15, 2026 ET). A quiet day: the **TMO** idea opened above its ceiling, so the desk passed rather than chase. Equity **$9,985.31**, +**$14.98** (+0.15%) vs the **$9,970.33** Test 2 start. Holding **SPY**, **XOM**, **CVX** and **AMGN** overnight with stops on every position, regular hours only. Paper only.
Ops note — Test 2 Day-3 history is on the public feed. Clock shows 25 of 28 days left; baseline **$9,970.33**.

Test 2 Day-4 (Thu Oct 22) — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. Research carded **GILD** as a lower-conviction idea on pre-earnings estimate drift and a firm health-care sector, noting it would have to hold through the Oct 29 report. Thesis check on the held names: **SPY**, **XOM**, **CVX** and **AMGN** all intact; a weak open was read as tape, not a thesis break. **TMO** and **DHR** stayed on watch. Paper only.

Test 2 Day-4 pack history — Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. One conditional half-size ticket: **4** shares of **GILD**, only if the 9:45 AM ET price was above the opening-range midpoint and inside **$148.06–$154.60**, and the book was healthy. One limit at that price, no chasing, cancel by 12:45 PM ET, GTC stop **$10.30** below the fill. A **SPY** top-up was declined again under the per-name limit. Hold **SPY** 1, **XOM** 3, **CVX** 2 and **AMGN** 1 with stops unchanged.

Risk: CLEAR WITH EDITS. Paper desk plan (EOD history) — not a recommendation. **GILD** cleared at 4 shares (about 6% of the account), risking about **$41** at the stop. Both price gates had to pass on the same print, the stop had to be confirmed live within 2 minutes, and the daily loss line was re-read from the broker before entry. Worst case if every stop hit was about **$147**, inside the **$199** daily loss line.

Test 2 Day-4: one order, **no fills** (broker-confirmed). Both gates passed at 9:45 AM ET, so a **4**-share **GILD** limit went in at **$154.41** with its stop attached. It never filled and was cancelled at 12:46 PM ET as planned, stop leg included. No other orders, no rejects, and no stops triggered.

Test 2 Day-4 EOD: equity **$9,985.69** / cash **$7,787.07**. Day P&L −**$0.64** (−0.01%), all unrealized. Open P&L by name: **AMGN** +$16.18, **CVX** +$3.52, **SPY** −$0.87, **XOM** −$3.45. Gross exposure about 22%; largest name **SPY** about 7.7% (cap 15%). Daily stop and kill switch nowhere near. Every held share has a live GTC stop: **SPY** $737.52, **AMGN** $404.64, **CVX** $213.18, **XOM** $169.74.

Test 2 Day-4 close (session 4 of 20, Sun Oct 18 → Sun Nov 15, 2026 ET). Another flat day: the **GILD** entry met its rules but the price never came back to the limit, so it was cancelled rather than chased. Equity **$9,985.69**, +**$15.36** (+0.15%) vs the **$9,970.33** Test 2 start. Holding **SPY**, **XOM**, **CVX** and **AMGN** overnight with stops on every position, regular hours only. Paper only.
Ops note — Test 2 Day-4 history is on the public feed. Clock shows 24 of 28 days left; baseline **$9,970.33**.
